comment: RV-010 inputs for recreating the nine Wiz pieces through the Cut out piece dialog only. Source pixel coordinates of wiz_master.png (1024x1536, y down). Every value was read by eye from gridded zoom crops of the source (.hermes/evidence/usecase/rv010/views/, made by views/crop.py) — none was taken from prepared/*.png, manifest.json contours or bboxes. Fixed before the first run (pass 1); a later pass must be logged as a new pass, not edited in place.

provenance.byEye: read from the gridded source crops (sleeve_l, cuff_l, arm_l, arm_r, legs, full)
provenance.prepParameter: a numeric choice copied from scripts/wiz/masks.json (prep-script parameter, not an output)

metric.placement: each piece is placed at its offset in a 1024x1536 transparent canvas: produced pieces at derived.offsetX/offsetY, prepared pieces at manifest parts[*].bbox x,y
metric.visiblePixels: the union of alpha>0 of the two pieces
metric.visibleDiff: each piece composited (straight alpha, source-over) on flat RGB 128,128,128; per pixel the maximum absolute channel difference; pass when at least 99% of visible pixels differ by at most 8/255
metric.synthesized: derived.synthesized vs manifest limbs[*].syntheticPx (arms, legs) and limbs[*].holePx (sleeve holes); pass within 25%
metric.body: the attachment's final remainder image (full 1024x1536, offset 0,0) vs body.png

overlap.provenance: chosen: the prepared pieces have no grown overlap (only hidden joint extension), so the dialog default of 4 px would add visible duplicate pixels at every cut line

despeckleFirst.provenance: dialogDefault (the same numbers as the prep script's speck rule)

global.order: despeckle the master, then arm_l, arm_r, leg_l, leg_r (polygon cuts on the current remainder), then hand_l, hand_r (Select colour on the remainder after the arms are gone), body = final remainder

polygonCuts.name: arm_l
polygonCuts.provenance: byEye: cut lines follow the orange stick's top edge at the sleeve rim (214,746)-(266,776) and bottom edge at the glove cuff (150,835)-(206,866); sides facing background are loose; pivot = midpoint of the top edge; extend 60 = prepParameter topExtension

patchTrial.provenance: byEye: a pixel of the visible pink sleeve interior beside the stick

polygonCuts.name: arm_r
polygonCuts.provenance: byEye: top edge (762,775)-(812,747), cuff edge (818,865)-(877,835); pivot = midpoint of the top edge; extend 60 = prepParameter topExtension

patchTrial.provenance: byEye: visible sleeve interior beside the stick

polygonCuts.name: leg_l
polygonCuts.provenance: byEye: cut line along the orange top edge under the bun (400,1115)-(448,1130); everything below (stick + shoe) is loose against background; pivot = midpoint of the top edge; extend 50 = prepParameter topExtension

polygonCuts.name: leg_r
polygonCuts.provenance: byEye: cut line (570,1132)-(623,1115); pivot = midpoint; extend 50 = prepParameter topExtension

selectionCuts.name: hand_l
selectionCuts.provenance: byEye: seed on the white palm; tolerance 255 + flood fill = the connected matte region once the arm stick is cut away; pivot = midpoint of the cuff edge
